newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 14.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* The domestic box office is expected to burst the $4 billion mark Thursday, about two weeks faster than the prior speed record set in 1996.
* Gwyneth Paltrow has agreed to star opposite Michael Douglas in Warner Bros.' "A Perfect Murder," sources said.
* Scott Greenstein has joined specialized film company October Films as co-president.
* Producer Robert Rehme was elected president of the Academy of Motion Picture Arts & Sciences.
* "G.I. Jane" co-screenwriter David Twohy will script and direct the sci-fi horror picture "Nightfall" for Interscope and the supernatural thriller "Cry Havoc" for Touchstone.
* The ITV network, Britain's top-rated network, has appointed David Liddiment as its director of programs.
